BP1.desc: 成都厂2025-08草鱼料出成率降至91%（基准约96%），当月在厂玉米批次水分偏高(约15.5% vs 正常12.5%)
BP1.check_sql: SELECT factory, product, month, ROUND(SUM(output_t)/SUM(input_t)*100,2) AS yield_pct FROM fact_production WHERE factory='成都厂' AND product='草鱼料' AND month IN ('2025-07','2025-08','2025-09') GROUP BY 1,2,3

BP2.desc: 供应商S03在2025Q3的豆粕蛋白均值41.2%，低于正常43%
BP2.check_sql: SELECT supplier, ROUND(AVG(protein_pct),2) FROM fact_qc_batch WHERE ingredient='豆粕' AND month BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-09' GROUP BY supplier ORDER BY 2

BP3.desc: 华东区域2025H2回款天数从约45天升至约78天
BP3.check_sql: SELECT region, CASE WHEN month<'2025-07' THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS half, ROUND(AVG(dso_days),1) FROM fact_sales GROUP BY 1,2

BP4.desc: 眉山厂2025-03豆粕采购量约为月均3倍，且当月豆粕价处区间高位
BP4.check_sql: SELECT month, SUM(qty_t) FROM fact_purchase WHERE factory='眉山厂' AND ingredient='豆粕' GROUP BY month ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

BP5.desc: 重庆区域2025-09 OTIF降至约0.82（旺季运力不足）
BP5.check_sql: SELECT region, month, ROUND(AVG(on_time*in_full),3) AS otif FROM fact_sales WHERE region='重庆' AND month IN ('2025-08','2025-09','2025-10') GROUP BY 1,2

BP6.desc: 鲈鱼膨化料2025-07吨成本环比大涨，主因鱼粉采购价处于高点（价格效应主导）
BP6.check_sql: SELECT month, ROUND(AVG(unit_price),0) FROM fact_purchase WHERE ingredient='鱼粉' GROUP BY month ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3
